text:
Russell and Leclerc share the front row in Baku. Here's the provisional Azerbaijan GP starting grid, with penalties applied.

#AzerbaijanGP #F1

metadata.altText: Grand Prix Picks graphic showing Baku's provisional starting grid for 26 September 2026 in lime and charcoal, with an illustration of the old city and Flame Towers. Grid: 1 Russell, 2 Leclerc, 3 Piastri, 4 Hadjar, 5 Norris, 6 Hamilton, 7 Gasly, 8 Verstappen, 9 Colapinto, 10 Bearman, 11 Lawson, 12 Albon, 13 Ocon, 14 Sainz, 15 Lindblad, 16 Antonelli, 17 Bortoleto, 18 Hulkenberg, 19 Bottas, 20 Perez, 21 Alonso, 22 Stroll.
